**Which address, and which picture?**

<!-- The filename is the address. Say what it is in words too: the token's symbol or
     the protocol's name, so a reviewer knows what they are looking at. -->

**Where did the bytes come from?**

<!-- A link. The token's own publisher, or the protocol's own site or brand kit. This
     goes in sources.json as well; it is the only record that survives into the bucket.
     "Found it on a search" is not a source — the made mark it would replace is honest,
     and a picture nobody can trace is not. -->

**How do you know it belongs to that address?**

<!-- The part no check can do for you. A logo beside an amount on the screen where
     somebody decides whether to sign is this project vouching for it. Say what makes
     you sure: the address is printed on that site, the publisher's own metadata points
     at it, you took it from the docs that also give the program id. -->
